subject: Web Development
title: Garbage Collection
description: Learn Garbage Collection in one minute.

hook.text: JavaScript creates objects constantly. If nothing cleaned up, memory would run out fast.

buildup.text: Garbage collection automatically finds objects that are no longer reachable and frees them.

discovery.text: V8 uses a generational approach: most objects die young and are collected quickly.

twist.text: Major garbage collection pauses can freeze the page for milliseconds — visible as small stutters.

climax.text: Modern engines use incremental and concurrent collection to minimize those pauses.

punchline.text: Invisible janitors keep the web running.

quiz.question: Why does garbage collection sometimes cause stutters?
